failures.text: Nobody on our team can log in through SSO — Every user in our workspace is bounced back to the login page after authenticating with our identity provider. It started about twenty minutes ago and affects the entire team.

My laptop keeps logging me out of the console — Only me, and only on my laptop. Signing in again works fine and it happens maybe once a day. No rush on this one.

All dashboards blank and saved reports missing for every customer — Nothing renders at all and saved reports have disappeared from the list. This is production and customer facing.

failures.text: Intermittent 500s on the connector, but only in our sandbox — We see 500 errors on maybe one in ten calls. This is sandbox only — production is completely fine and no customer is affected.

Weekly executive report empty after workspace migration — We migrated our team to a new workspace on Friday. Since then the weekly executive report renders with no rows for the whole team, although the underlying data is visible if we open the saved report directly. We suspect the migration did not carry over whatever grant the report needs.
